notes: Read SKILL.md and references/examples.md in full. Guidance and Java samples for the official Azure Storage Blob SDK (azure-storage-blob 12.33.0): service/container/blob clients, upload/download (data, file, stream), listing, delete, copy, SAS generation, metadata, leases, error handling and proxy config.

No commands, installs, credentials, or agent-side network access: installation is pinned Maven XML (or the Azure SDK BOM) for the user's pom.xml, the only bash fence lists placeholder environment variables, and all upload/download/delete and credential code (shared key from env vars, SAS, DefaultAzureCredential) runs only in the user's application.

The complete example in references/examples.md:354-410 creates and then deletes a container in the user's storage account when run, and uses an account key; users should prefer Entra ID auth as the skill recommends. No hidden content or external file dependencies.
